verdict: Lennox grew revenue 10% to $1.6B as its commercial business surged 24%, but inflation and tariff costs squeezed margins and profit fell to $221M.

kpis.label: Adjusted EPS
kpis.note: excludes restructuring, litigation and acquisition items

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: Operating cash flow of $395M less net capex

segments.name: Home Comfort Solutions
segments.note: Heating, cooling and air quality for homes. Revenue rose 3% as residential markets stabilized, but profit fell 18% — price cuts to defend share, product-cost inflation including tariffs, and $15M of higher fuel costs all weighed.

segments.name: Building Climate Solutions
segments.note: Commercial HVAC, refrigeration and services. Revenue rose 24% (15% organic, the rest from acquisitions) and profit rose 19% to $167M, at a still-strong 26.2% margin.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling products, distribution and the back office — up from $162M a year ago on inflation and investment.

opex.name: Losses, restructuring & other, net
opex.note: $5M of losses and other expenses (including $3M of special litigation charges and $4M of acquisition costs) plus $8M of restructuring charges, partly offset by a $4M gain on selling previous dispositions and $1M of equity-method income.

otherDetail: Net expense of $19M: $18M of net interest expense plus $1M of other expense.
oneTimers: Adjusted net income was $236M ($6.84 per share) vs GAAP $221M ($6.41) — the gap is restructuring charges, special litigation charges and acquisition costs, partly offset by a $4M gain on selling previous dispositions.

takeaways.title: Commercial is carrying growth
takeaways.text: Building Climate Solutions revenue rose 24% to $635M — 15% organic growth plus acquisitions — with profit up 19% to $167M. Home Comfort grew only 3%.

takeaways.title: Home margins squeezed hard
takeaways.text: Home Comfort's margin fell 490 basis points to 18.7% and profit dropped 18% to $176M, hit by $32M of product-cost inflation and tariffs, lower factory absorption and price actions to defend share.

takeaways.title: Full-year guidance cut
takeaways.text: Lennox cut full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $21.00–$21.50 (midpoint $21.25) from $23.00–$24.00, while raising free cash flow guidance to $700–750M. Q3 operating cash flow rose to $395M as inventories fell.

footerNote: Lennox reports in tenths of a million; this page rounds to whole millions (revenue $1,572M vs the reported $1,572.5M) so the flow balances exactly. Segment profit ($323M including corporate) differs from GAAP operating income ($312M) by the restructuring, litigation, acquisition and gain items listed above.
